text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Ardan-senpai's return has finally been 
decided. However, after watching 
Oguri-senpai run, she seems really uneasy 
about it...

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
“Yet Ardan-senpai has a burning passion to 
chase after her 'dream'! Even if she 
doesn't believe in herself, I told her 
that I believe in her!”

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
The next day, Ardan-senpai said she'd come 
watch the Takamatsunomiya Kinen! She told 
me she wants to feel the fiery passion I'm 
pouring into my "dream"!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
To show my true power, to show my 
"dream"!! I'm gonna win!! The 
Takamatsunomiya Kinen!!!
